items.title: Wall Street sube después de que Waller de la Fed dice que podría apoyar mantenimiento de tasas
items.author: Niket Nishant, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.creator: Niket Nishant, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.summary: Los principales índices de Wall Street abrieron al alza el jueves, después de que el gobernador de la Reserva Federal Christopher Waller dijera que podría apoyar mantener las tasas de interés sin cambios este mes si los datos confirman que las presiones sobre los precios se están moderando.
items.body:
Los principales índices de Wall Street abrieron al alza el jueves, después de que el gobernador de la Reserva Federal Christopher Waller dijera que podría apoyar mantener las tasas de interés sin cambios este mes si los datos confirman que las presiones sobre los precios se están moderando.
* Estas declaraciones llevaron a los operadores a reducir sus apuestas a favor de un alza de tasas y podrían disipar el pesimismo en los mercados tras los últimos enfrentamientos militares entre Estados Unidos e Irán.
* "Mi decisión sobre la orientación adecuada de la política monetaria se verá muy influida por lo que sepamos sobre la inflación de agosto", dijo Waller en unas declaraciones realizadas en un evento de Reuters NEXT Newsmaker celebrado en Washington. "Si se sigue avanzando hacia nuestro objetivo del 2%, estaré dispuesto a apoyar el mantenimiento de la tasa oficial en su nivel actual".
* No obstante, señaló que podría ser necesario subir los costos de financiación si los datos de inflación muestran que persisten las presiones sobre los precios. Según la herramienta FedWatch de CME, los operadores ven cerca de un 48% de probabilidades de que se produzca una subida este mes.
* La volatilidad previa a las elecciones de mitad de mandato y la posible disminución de la liquidez en septiembre crean "un escenario en el que los inversores pueden reaccionar de forma exagerada y el mercado puede experimentar altibajos", señaló.
* Un conflicto prolongado en Oriente Medio también podría complicar aún más las perspectivas de tasas, al agravar las presiones inflacionarias. Los futuros del crudo Brent subían un 0,49% en la sesión, su cuarto día consecutivo de ganancias.
* El Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) subía 394,74 puntos, o un 0,74%, a 53.456,69 unidades; el índice S&P 500 (.SPX) sumaba 41,29 puntos, o un 0,54%, a 7.707,89 unidades; y el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) ganaba 160,2 puntos, o un 0,61%, a 26.378,03 unidades.
* Broadcom (AVGO.O) caía un 5,26%, después de que sus previsiones de ingresos para el cuarto trimestre no alcanzaran las elevadas expectativas de Wall Street, lo que pone de relieve que las empresas que están en el centro de la expansión de la inteligencia artificial tienen un listón muy alto que superar.

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場・午前＝ドル下げ幅拡大、155円台半ば　ウォラーＦＲＢ理事発言受け
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　３日　ロイター］ - ３日午前のニューヨーク外為市場で、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のウォラー理事の発言を受け、ドルが対円で下げ幅を拡大した。

円は対ドルで１．９９％高の１５５．６０円。７月の為替介入後に付けた高値の１５５．２１円に接近しており、この水準を上抜ければ５月６日以来の円高・ドル安水準となる。

ウォラー理事はロイター主催イベント「ロイターネクスト」で、今後発表される経済指標でインフレ圧力の鈍化が確認されれば、１５─１６日の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で政策金利の据え置きを支持する考えを示した。同時に、「インフレ指標が予想以上に強い内容になれば利上げを検討する」と述べ、利上げの可能性も排除しなかった。

items.title: Preços do café recuam no Vietnã em mercado calmo
items.author: Phuong Nguyen, Mas Alina Arifin
items.creator: Phuong Nguyen, Mas Alina Arifin
items.summary: Os preços do café robusta no Vietnã caíram ainda mais nesta semana devido a um mercado pouco animado, marcado por estoques baixos e demanda fraca após o longo feriado nacional do país, enquanto os prêmios do robusta indonésio subiram, informaram os comerciantes nesta quinta-feira.
items.body:
Os preços do café robusta no Vietnã caíram ainda mais nesta semana devido a um mercado pouco animado, marcado por estoques baixos e demanda fraca após o longo feriado nacional do país, enquanto os prêmios do robusta indonésio subiram, informaram os comerciantes nesta quinta-feira.
Os produtores do Planalto Central, o cinturão cafeeiro do Vietnã, venderam grãos a preços entre 91.200 e 92.000 dongs (US$3,50 a US$3,53) por kg, abaixo da faixa de 95.700 a 96.200 dongs registrada na semana passada.
"As pessoas ainda não voltaram do feriado. O mercado está muito calmo agora", disse um corretor da região cafeeira.
Os contratos futuros de café robusta para novembro fecharam em queda de US$14, a US$3.392 por tonelada métrica na quarta-feira.
Outro ofereceu 89.500 dongs por kg para café a ser entregue em dezembro.
"Embora o USDA tenha estimado que a produção na safra atual seria semelhante à anterior, muitos agricultores afirmaram que um grande número de cerejas verdes havia caído das árvores, gerando preocupações quanto à produção", disse o corretor.
O Vietnã exportou 1,33 milhão de toneladas métricas de café nos primeiros oito meses de 2026, um aumento de 13,7% em relação ao mesmo período do ano anterior, segundo dados do governo. A receita com as exportações de café nesse período caiu 8,6%, para US$ 6 bilhões. Somente em agosto, o país exportou 132.000 toneladas, um aumento de 13,7% em relação ao ano anterior.
Na Indonésia, os grãos de café robusta de Sumatra foram oferecidos com um prêmio de US$300 em relação ao contrato de novembro nesta semana, disse um trader, um aumento em relação ao prêmio de US$260 da semana passada para o mesmo período.
Outro trader informou que os grãos foram oferecidos com um prêmio de US$200 em relação ao contrato de outubro, um aumento em relação ao prêmio de US$175 da semana passada para o período de setembro.

items.title: Israel liberará a cinco detenidos libaneses en el marco de las conversaciones con el Líbano
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Israel liberará a cinco ciudadanos libaneses detenidos en el sur del Líbano tras comprobar que no tenían vínculos con grupos militantes, según informó el jueves la oficina del primer ministro Benjamin Netanyahu.
items.body:
Israel liberará a cinco ciudadanos libaneses detenidos en el sur del Líbano tras comprobar que no tenían vínculos con grupos militantes, según informó el jueves la oficina del primer ministro Benjamin Netanyahu.
Según la oficina, la decisión se tomó en el marco de las negociaciones con el Líbano para recuperar los restos mortales de los líderes de la comunidad judía secuestrados y asesinados allí a mediados de la década de 1980.
Israel y el Líbano han llevado a cabo varias iniciativas en los últimos meses para localizar los restos, incluidas operaciones sobre el terreno, según la oficina de Netanyahu.
Israel ya ha liberado a uno de los cinco, Malek Kamal Ghazi, que fue capturado en octubre de 2025 y entregado por la Cruz Roja a las autoridades libanesas en el paso fronterizo de Naqoura, según informaron a Reuters una fuente de seguridad libanesa y una fuente de la comisión de prisioneros.
Las fuentes desmintieron las informaciones que apuntaban a que Ghazi era miembro de Hezbolá y afirmaron que los otros cuatro que iban a ser liberados también eran civiles. Señalaron que 35 detenidos libaneses permanecían en Israel, entre ellos 20 civiles.
Israel y el Líbano firmaron en junio un acuerdo marco mediado por Estados Unidos que incluía el compromiso de trabajar por la liberación de los detenidos y la búsqueda y repatriación de los restos mortales.
El acuerdo también prevé una retirada israelí eventual del sur del Líbano, a medida que el ejército libanés asuma el control y desarme a Hezbolá, grupo respaldado por Irán, condiciones que este último ha rechazado.

items.title: Índices sobem após diretor do Fed afirmar que pode defender manutenção dos juros
items.author: Niket Nishant, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.creator: Niket Nishant, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.summary: Os principais índices de Wall Street operavam em alta nesta quinta-feira depois que o diretor do Federal Reserve Christopher Waller afirmou que pode defender manutenção da taxa de juros neste mês caso os dados confirmem que as pressões sobre os preços estão diminuindo.
items.body:
Os principais índices de Wall Street operavam em alta nesta quinta-feira depois que o diretor do Federal Reserve Christopher Waller afirmou que pode defender manutenção da taxa de juros neste mês caso os dados confirmem que as pressões sobre os preços estão diminuindo.
Os comentários levaram os operadores a reduzir as apostas em um aumento dos juros e podem dissipar o clima de pessimismo nos mercados após os recentes confrontos militares entre os Estados Unidos e o Irã.
“Minha decisão sobre a postura adequada da política monetária será fortemente influenciada pelo que soubermos sobre a inflação de agosto”, disse Waller em um discurso preparado para ser proferido em um evento do Reuters NEXT Newsmaker em Washington.
“Se houver progresso contínuo em direção à nossa meta de 2%, estarei disposto a defender a manutenção da taxa de juros no nível atual”, disse Waller.
Mas os custos dos empréstimos podem precisar subir se os dados de inflação mostrarem que as pressões sobre os preços persistem, disse ele. Os operadores ainda esperam uma chance de quase 48% de alta nos juros neste mês, de acordo com a ferramenta CME FedWatch.
A volatilidade antes das eleições de meio de mandato e a liquidez potencialmente mais escassa em setembro criam “um cenário em que os investidores podem reagir de forma exagerada e o mercado pode apresentar altos e baixos”, disse Kim Forrest, diretora de investimentos da Bokeh Capital Partners.
Investidores ávidos por catalisadores positivos agora estão de olho nos dados de emprego nos EUA na sexta-feira, mas alguns alertaram para não se dar muita ênfase ao relatório já que o chair do Federal Reserve, Kevin Warsh, indicou que controlar a inflação continua sendo sua principal prioridade.
Um conflito prolongado no Oriente Médio também poderia complicar ainda mais as perspectivas para os juros ao agravar as pressões inflacionárias. Os contratos futuros do petróleo Brent subiam 0,49% nesta quinta-feira, quarto dia consecutivo de ganhos.
O Índice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) subia 0,74%, para 53.456,69 pontos, enquanto o S&P 500 (.SPX) avançava 0,54%, a 7.707,89 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) tinha alta de 0,61%, para 26.378,03 pontos.
items.raw_description: Os principais índices de Wall Street operavam em alta nesta quinta-feira depois que o diretor do Federal Reserve Christopher Waller afirmou que pode defender manutenção da taxa de juros neste mês caso os dados confirmem que as pressões sobre os preços estão diminuindo.

items.title: América desafía el dominio petrolero de Medio Oriente
items.author: Javier Blas
items.summary: América desafía el dominio petrolero de Medio Oriente. El nuevo mapa energético; al cerrarse prácticamente el estrecho de Ormuz en marzo y abril, la producción de Medio Oriente se redujo, lo que causó ...
items.body: Durante algunas semanas de 2026, el continente americano produjo casi la mitad del petróleo mundial. Fue un momento extraordinario, aunque breve. En cierta medida, se trató de una anomalía estadística, un afortunado efecto secundario de la guerra con Irán, que paralizó gran parte de la industria energética del Golfo Pérsico. Pero también fue un indicador muy real de un auge que ha desplazado el centro de gravedad del mercado petrolero fuera de Medio Oriente. Ese aumento de la producción —y la reorganización que conlleva— se extenderá hasta 2027 y muy probablemente más allá, actuando como un fuerte contrapeso a las presiones sobre los precios provocadas por el conflicto en curso. Hasta ahora, varios factores han contribuido a mantener bajos los precios del petróleo. La liberación de reservas estratégicas está ayudando, al igual que los oleoductos de derivación. China ha reducido drásticamente sus importaciones, liberando barriles para el resto del mundo. Además, sigue fluyendo más petróleo por el estrecho de Ormuz de lo que se suele creer. Pero el auge económico estadounidense también está contribuyendo a ello. Si bien la revolución del gas de esquisto en Estados Unidos sigue siendo uno de los acontecimientos geoeconómicos menos valorados de los últimos 25 años, el auge de la producción petrolera en el resto de América, especialmente en Brasil y Canadá, pasa aún más desapercibido. Este crecimiento resulta aún más impresionante si se tiene en cuenta que dos de los que alguna vez fueron los principales productores de la región han visto desplomarse su producción: Venezuela, debido a la mala gestión política, y México, debido a factores geológicos. En conjunto, las Américas bombean actualmente unos 39,5 millones de barriles diarios de crudo y otros líquidos derivados del petróleo. Además, el continente produce otros 2,5 millones de barriles de etanol y biodiésel, que generalmente se consideran parte de su producción total de petróleo. Esto suma 42 millones de barriles diarios, más que cualquier otra región, incluido Medio Oriente. El himno estadounidense dice que el país es “la tierra de los libres y el hogar de los valientes”. Tal es la bonanza energética que podría decirse que las Américas se están convirtiendo en la tierra de los petroleros, el hogar de las riquezas petroleras. En tiempos normales, el petróleo estadounidense representa aproximadamente el 40% de la producción mundial, pero durante esas pocas semanas de marzo, esta cifra superó el 45% debido a que Arabia Saudita, Kuwait, Irak, Qatar, Bahréin y los Emiratos Árabes Unidos se vieron obligados a cerrar sus pozos tras el cierre del estrecho de Ormuz. Para una región donde muchos países habían estado preocupados durante mucho tiempo por su dependencia del petróleo extranjero, se trata de una abundancia sin precedentes. En el año 2000, América representaba alrededor del 26% de la producción mundial, y eso antes del declive en Venezuela y México. El tamaño no es el único indicador importante: el crecimiento también es fundamental. América está produciendo alrededor de 1,6 millones de barriles diarios más que hace un año, suficiente para cubrir el doble del aumento típico de la demanda mundial anual. Esto supera las predicciones de la mayoría de hace unos meses, incluidas mis propias expectativas optimistas, superiores al consenso. En comparación con hace dos años, los continentes están produciendo 3,2 millones de barriles adicionales. Cinco países representan la mayor parte del aumento: Estados Unidos, Canadá, Brasil, Guyana y Argentina; un sexto, Venezuela, se suma a esta tendencia este año. La revolución del gas de esquisto en Estados Unidos es el aspecto más conocido del auge en América. Y es una fuente inagotable de beneficios. Hace poco, un ejecutivo petrolero me comentó en tono de broma que la producción siguió aumentando a principios de año, incluso cuando su empresa se había propuesto mantenerla estable, todo gracias a las mejoras en la eficiencia. Ahora, el incremento se acelerará a medida que las empresas pasen de una estrategia de crecimiento constante a una de crecimiento moderado. En mayo, según los datos más recientes disponibles, Estados Unidos bombeó alrededor de 13,7 millones de barriles de crudo, además de otros 8 millones de barriles de otros líquidos derivados del petróleo y casi 1,5 millones de barriles de biocombustibles. El crudo —con mucho, el más importante de los tres— probablemente alcanzará pronto los 14 millones de barriles diarios y seguirá aumentando mientras los precios del petróleo se mantengan por encima de los 70 dólares por barril. Los demás también aumentarán. Con los precios del petróleo por encima de lo previsto hace apenas unos meses, no solo ha aumentado el número de plataformas de perforación en operación a su nivel más alto en un año, sino que también ha subido el número de cuadrillas que ponen en producción los pozos a su nivel más alto en 16 meses. Además de las mejoras en la eficiencia y el aumento de la actividad de perforación y terminación de pozos, otro factor crucial contribuirá en la segunda mitad del año: la recuperación de los precios del gas natural en la Cuenca Pérmica. Cuando las empresas de esquisto perforan en la cuenca Pérmica, la región rica en energía que se extiende desde el oeste de Texas hasta el sureste de Nuevo México, suelen bombear gas natural junto con el petróleo. La producción de este gas, denominado gas asociado, se ha triplicado con creces desde 2018, desbordando la demanda local y la capacidad de los gasoductos. Durante meses, los productores de esquisto pagaron —sí, pagaron— a los consumidores para que se llevaran su gas. Con todos los gasoductos capaces de transportar las moléculas al máximo de su capacidad, el precio de este gas en el centro de Waha, en el corazón de la cuenca Pérmica, alcanzó un mínimo histórico de -10 dólares por millón de unidades térmicas británicas a finales de abril, el punto más bajo en 132 días de precios negativos entre febrero y junio. Los precios del gas natural licuado (Waha) han repuntado hasta superar los 2 dólares por millón de Btu gracias a la apertura de nueva capacidad de gasoductos, incluyendo la ampliación del Gulf Coast Express, desarrollado por Kinder Morgan Inc., y la inauguración del nuevo gasoducto Hugh Brinson, a cargo de Energy Transfer LP. Se prevé que otro nuevo gasoducto, el Blackcomb, de un consorcio liderado por WhiteWater, comience a operar a finales de este año. Con la subida de los precios del gas, las compañías de esquisto pudieron incrementar la producción, ya sea perforando más pozos o reactivando los que habían sido cerrados o paralizados por los precios negativos. Permian Resources Corp. ( PR ), una pequeña empresa de esquisto, comunicó a los inversores a principios de este mes que se vio obligada a reducir la producción de sus pozos durante el segundo trimestre, pero la situación ha cambiado desde entonces. “Cuando los precios de Waha mejoraron a finales de junio, volvimos a poner en producción todos los pozos que habían sido paralizados sin ningún problema operativo”, declaró Will Hickey, co-CEO de Permian, haciéndose eco de una tendencia observada por muchas otras empresas. La actividad también se ha acelerado fuera de Estados Unidos, con Brasil, Guyana y Argentina alcanzando máximos históricos de producción el mes pasado. Canadá también está en camino de alcanzar su mayor producción anual este año. Para finales de 2027, Brasil y Canadá juntos producirán más petróleo que Arabia Saudita. Guyana producirá tanto crudo como Libia. Un estudio de JPMorgan & Co. destaca una razón clave por la que el auge continuará: los nuevos proyectos en alta mar en Brasil y Guyana generarán beneficios a lo largo de muchos años y, por lo tanto, son relativamente inmunes a las fluctuaciones de los precios del petróleo. Los barriles adicionales en Canadá y Argentina provienen de productores de bajo costo que seguirán invirtiendo incluso si los precios bajan el próximo año. El mapa petrolero mundial se ha transformado mucho más de lo que se suele creer. La inestabilidad en Medio Oriente garantizará una mayor inversión en el desarrollo regional de América, impulsando la producción a niveles cada vez mayores y desplazando aún más la industria hacia Occidente. Una nueva tierra petrolera, al alcance de Washington. Esta nota no refleja necesariamente la opinión del consejo editorial de Bloomberg LP y sus propietarios. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Número de militares iranianos que teriam sido mortos em ataques dos EUA nesta semana sobe para 13
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A agência de notícias semioficial iraniana Tasnim informou nesta quinta-feira a morte de mais seis militares em ataques dos EUA nesta semana, elevando o número de mortos entre os militares para pelo menos 13.
items.body:
A agência de notícias semioficial iraniana Tasnim informou nesta quinta-feira a morte de mais seis militares em ataques dos EUA nesta semana, elevando o número de mortos entre os militares para pelo menos 13.
Os ataques dos EUA na terça-feira foram os mais intensos das últimas semanas. No relatório mais recente sobre as mortes de militares, a Tasnim informou que seis membros das Forças Armadas regulares, incluindo três pilotos, foram mortos no sul do Irã. A agência não forneceu detalhes adicionais sobre o local.
A Tasnim havia informado anteriormente que os ataques de terça-feira haviam matado três membros da milícia paramilitar Basij na Ilha de Lavan, no Golfo, cujo funeral ocorreu no sul do Irã na quarta-feira.
Os ataques também mataram quatro membros da Força Aeroespacial da Guarda Revolucionária Islâmica (IRGC) no oeste do Irã, de acordo com um comunicado da Guarda publicado na quarta-feira.
As baixas militares iranianas no conflito que começou no final de fevereiro têm sido relatadas periodicamente, sem confirmação oficial do número total de vítimas.
A guerra, que começou com ataques dos EUA e de Israel ao Irã, já deixou milhares de mortos, a grande maioria deles no Irã e no Líbano.
Na quarta-feira, uma autoridade do Ministério da Saúde iraniano afirmou no X que, de 30 de agosto a 2 de setembro, 18 pessoas haviam sido mortas — incluindo quatro que participavam de um casamento — e 142 ficaram feridas, chamando novamente a atenção para o número de mortos entre a população civil.
A Tasnim também informou que os ataques dos EUA ao sul do Irã no domingo, que ocorreram após um mês de trégua nos confrontos, mataram três pessoas. Duas delas foram identificadas como membros da Marinha do Corpo da Guarda Revolucionária Islâmica pela agência de notícias iraniana Nournews.
Os EUA informaram que 18 militares foram mortos e mais de 750 ficaram feridos na guerra.

items.title: Ireland’s Martin Says Russia Is Becoming More Reckless
items.summary: Russia’s aggression is becoming an existential threat for the eastern members of the European Union, Irish Prime Minister Micheal Martin said, as he condemned a drone attack in Germany that’s been blamed on Russia. “Russia is aggressive. And as we see in Leipzig, to a degree, very reckless as well now,” Martin told Bloomberg's Jennifer Duggan during an interview in Dublin. “And becoming more reckless in terms of what it’s looking at endeavoring to do on the side of European member states. This is a particular reality that we cannot ignore.” (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Forced labour: Will the EU’s threat of product bans succeed where supply-chain audits failed?
items.author: Oliver Balch
items.creator: Oliver Balch
items.summary: From December next year, companies face losing access to the European Union if their products are found to have been made with forced labour. The EU’s Forced Labour Regulation will provide belt and braces to its Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive, where companies in scope must identify, prevent, mitigate and account for adverse human rights and environmental impacts in their operations, subsidiaries and value chains.
items.body:
From December next year, companies face losing access to the European Union if their products are found to have been made with forced labour. The EU’s Forced Labour Regulation will provide belt and braces to its Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive, where companies in scope must identify, prevent, mitigate and account for adverse human rights and environmental impacts in their operations, subsidiaries and value chains.
While campaigners say effective enforcement of the forced labour regulation will require the European Commission and EU member states to significantly boost their investigative capacity, the prospect of product bans could be the stick that will encourage companies to carry out due diligence required under the CSDDD.
What is clear is that voluntary due diligence approaches by companies have not succeeded in eliminating forced labour and other human rights abuses from global supply chains, despite the fact they have spawned a social auditing industry valued at $19.36 billion .
Around the world, 27.6 million people are estimated to be the victims of forced labour , and 63% of them in the private economy. Human rights groups say wage theft, unsafe working conditions and harassment are widespread, with migrants and other vulnerable workers especially affected.
Critics of the due diligence systems include suppliers, who complain of audit fatigue, and labour rights groups, who arguing that third-party assessments fail to capture the full picture , either because the audits are too superficial, too short, or because workers feel intimidated.
A worker collects palm oil fruits at a plantation in Malaysia. Global human rights groups have repeatedly raised concerns over systemic labour abuses and poor working conditions across the sector. REUTERS/Bazuki Muhammad Neil Willings, global head of sustainability and supply chain at global compliance company SGS, insists that robust and diligent auditing offers companies a “solid baseline” about suppliers’ current performance as well as identifying areas for improvement.
He also rejects a common assumption that supplier audits are laxer for being voluntary. He cites the 10-year-old Association of Professional Social Compliance Auditors (APSCA) as evidence of the sector’s robustness. Set up by the likes of Bureau Veritas, Intertek and SGS, the industry body now counts over 75 verified members, including most of the world’s major social audit providers.
“There are still some pockets where industries choose to ignore bad practices. But looking back over the decades, a lot of progress has been made to improve supply chain compliance and reduce the risk of worker abuses,” he asserts.
But Aruna Kashyap, associate director in the economic justice and rights division at campaign group Human Rights Watch, says most due diligence practices only look at one side of the story.
“Companies are reluctant to look at the actual commercial drivers that often underpin labour abuses, like how contract prices are set or how fast orders have to be turned around. It’s as if social audits are almost set up to fail.”
A new study , meanwhile, suggest that due diligence mechanisms are less important than the buyer-supplier relationships that sit above them.
Clothing is displayed for sale in a GAP store. The brand found that its suppliers were more likely to comply with its specified social requirements when they were in a longer-term commercial relationship. REUTERS/Mike Segar Based on historic 2018 audit data from the U.S. fast fashion brand GAP, the study, in the Strategic Management Journal, found that suppliers were more likely to comply with social requirements specified by GAP when they were in longer-term commercial relationship with the brand. Suppliers that faced high competition within their product category also proved more amenable to changing their practices.
Even more influential, however, is when there was a “threatened penalty” for failure to meet core labour standards: in this case, the loss of business.
GAP’s initial policy was to work with low-performing suppliers to encourage them to improve, but it then introduced the threat of cutting commercial ties if suppliers failed to improve fast enough.
The result was marked: an improvement by 0.8 standard deviations in supplier’s compliance scores and a 22-percentage-point fall in the probability of them failing their next audit. Without it, suppliers showed “no improvement” when they failed to meet GAP’s compliance requirements.
The fashion giant’s policy today strikes the same balance, a company spokesperson confirmed. “Gap Inc is committed to supporting factory partners through remediation if we identify non-compliances, but in some instances violations of our code of vendor conduct can result in termination of commercial relations.”
Matthew Amengual, an associate professor at Oxford University’s Saïd Business School and co-author of the paper, says the research provides at least three major takeaways. First, for voluntary approaches to work, buyers need to “show that they are serious”, by integrating corporate procurement and buying divisions into the compliance process.
A worker sews garments inside a garment factory in Faridabad, India. REUTERS/Priyanshu Singh If the sole message from a purchasing department remains on quality and cost, they are unlikely to take on board injunctions from the compliance department about social rights.
The second lesson is that relationships trump rules every time. If a supplier knows that a buyer won’t “cut and run”, either at the first hint of non-compliance or because of a lower-cost offer elsewhere, then the motivation to invest in social compliance measures is far higher, says Amengual.
It’s a sentiment echoed by Arianna Rossi, senior research and policy coordinator at the International Labour Organization (ILO), who argues that a policing approach is less needed when buyers and suppliers know and trust one another.
Buyers can foster such relationships not only through longer-term contracts or participation in joint labour accords, but also through financial or technical support for action plans put in place by suppliers to improve social standards.
Rossi cites the example of ACT for Cambodia , a “supply-chain supported” initiative between trade unions, suppliers and purchasing brands to encourage collective bargaining agreements in the country’s fashion and footwear sector.
“The kind of dialogue and opportunities to exchange ideas that a multistakeholder platform like this offers is really critical to helping brands hear the perspective of suppliers and workers, as well as to finding practical solutions to the problems behind instances of non-compliance,” she explains.
Women work on the production line of a footwear factory in Cambodia. The ACT for Cambodia initiative encourages collective bargaining agreements in the country’s fashion and footwear sector. REUTERS/Ann Wang Importantly, such a strategy turns penalties into a signal of intent to external stakeholders, who might otherwise interpret a buyer’s willingness to collaborate as condoning poor practice in its supply chain.
The third takeaway relates to the limitations of voluntary mechanisms, particularly when it comes to the power imbalance between suppliers and buyers.
Corporations are not blind to this, with responsible buyers encouraging measures such as whistleblowing and confidential employee interviews to give more voice to workers. A case in point is EcoVadis’s Ulula service , which, among other functions, provides workers with a confidential channel to report abuses and seek remediation via their mobile phones.
“Triangulating the information that suppliers provide with what workers provide is a good way to really get to the bottom of things and also to validate (audits, which) are a snapshot in time … What we can do here is something that happens much more continuously,” explains Antoine Heuty, founder of Ulula and senior vice-president of human rights at EcoVadis.
Amengual also sees merit in toughening the transparency criteria of mandatory due diligence laws so they include consistent reporting on outcomes of mitigation efforts, such as how often contracts are cancelled due to non-compliance or whether remediation plans increase compliance, he says.
At present, such data is almost impossible to obtain, Amengual states. Either companies don’t have the internal systems to offer an accurate picture, or, where they do have the data, they are reluctant to share it. As he notes: “No company wants to say, ‘Oh, we've gotten slightly better in our human rights violations’.”

items.title: AI cloud firm Nscale commits compute worth $3.5 billion for Figure's robotics ambitions
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: AI cloud firm Nscale on Thursday signed a multi-year deal to provide compute resources for the development of humanoid robotics company Figure's AI models and robots.
items.body:
AI cloud firm Nscale on Thursday signed a multi-year deal to provide compute resources for the development of humanoid robotics company Figure's AI models and robots.
Nscale said it will initially commit $3.5 billion in compute resources for Figure. Here are some key details:
Initial graphics processing units (GPUs) are targeted for deployment starting in the second half of 2027 in Barstow, Texas, Nscale said.
The AI cloud firm, which competes with CoreWeave (CRWV.O) and Nebius (NBIS.O) , plans to scale the computing investment to more than $6 billion.
Nscale said it will become a Figure shareholder and its preferred compute provider through the deal, powering the next generation of Figure's Helix models and humanoid robotics.
The companies will also explore scaling Nscale's supply chain with humanoids.
Nscale intends to potentially deploy up to 100,000 Nvidia (NVDA.O) chips for Figure.

items.title: Ex-Israeli NBA player's Swish Ventures raises $250 million for new VC Fund
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Israel's Swish Ventures said on Thursday it has raised $250 million for its third venture capital fund, which it has now closed to new investors.
items.body:
Israel's Swish Ventures said on Thursday it has raised $250 million for its third venture capital fund, which it has now closed to new investors.
Swish was founded in 2025 by Omri Casspi, the first Israeli to play in the National Basketball Association. He played between 2009 and 2019.
Swish's assets under management have grown to $800 million.
It has so far invested in 20 companies with a combined value of more than $60 billion. Eight of the companies are valued above $1 billion.
The new fund aims to invest in 12 companies with an average of $20 million per company, either as co-lead investor alongside another fund or as a participating investor.
It will focus on startups operating across cybersecurity, technology infrastructure, physical AI, defence, AI for industrial applications, and government technology.
Investments are made in the Seed and Series A stages, enabling it to continue investing through growth stages.
The fund's investors include existing Swish backers as well as new investors, including Sequoia Capital, U.S. institutional investors such as pension funds and American universities.

items.title: REUTERS NEXT Diretor do Fed Waller diz que taxa neutra pode ser mais alta, já que prêmio de segurança de Treasuries caiu
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Não há mais prêmio embutido nos preços dos títulos do governo dos EUA considerados seguros e líquidos, afirmou o diretor do Federal Reserve Christopher Waller, em um evento da Reuters NEXT Newsmaker nesta quinta-feira.
items.body:
Não há mais prêmio embutido nos preços dos títulos do governo dos EUA considerados seguros e líquidos, afirmou o diretor do Federal Reserve Christopher Waller, em um evento da Reuters NEXT Newsmaker nesta quinta-feira.
Waller afirmou que os rendimentos dos títulos -- inversamente proporcionais aos preços -- vêm subindo devido a preocupações com a situação fiscal, mas também por causa da competição por capital proveniente de investimentos em infraestrutura de inteligência artificial. Além disso, há evidências crescentes, segundo ele, de que o prêmio de segurança que impulsionava os preços dos Treasuries para cima e os rendimentos para baixo diminuiu.
Ele disse que há muito tempo se preocupa com o fato de que “não há mais prêmio para títulos do governo dos EUA seguros e líquidos”.
“E isso tem me levado a elevar minha estimativa da taxa neutra, o que implica taxas de juros de política monetária mais altas para qualquer taxa de inflação -- talvez você não esteja sendo tão restritivo quanto pensava”, acrescentou, em referência à política monetária do Fed.

items.author: Naveen Thukral
items.creator: Naveen Thukral
items.summary: Importadores asiáticos de trigo adquiriram pelo menos meio milhão de toneladas métricas de trigo australiano e argentino em negócios recentes, segundo três fontes do setor, à medida que os compradores se apressam para substituir cargas do Mar Negro atrasadas por ataques a navios e à infraestrutura de exportação de grãos.
items.body:
Importadores asiáticos de trigo adquiriram pelo menos meio milhão de toneladas métricas de trigo australiano e argentino em negócios recentes, segundo três fontes do setor, à medida que os compradores se apressam para substituir cargas do Mar Negro atrasadas por ataques a navios e à infraestrutura de exportação de grãos.
Os importadores da região, incluindo a Indonésia, o segundo maior comprador mundial de trigo, estão pagando preços significativamente mais altos por fontes alternativas de abastecimento, afirmaram as fontes, com vários países dependendo fortemente das importações para atender à demanda interna.
"Houve negócios em grande volume na última semana a dez dias envolvendo trigo australiano e argentino para atender a necessidades urgentes", disse um trader baseado na Ásia, de uma empresa de comércio internacional que fornece trigo a moinhos da região.
"Os importadores estão tentando obter remessas alternativas para cargas que não chegaram da Rússia e da Ucrânia."
Os importadores globais de trigo enfrentam escassez de oferta, já que os ataques russos e ucranianos a portos e embarcações interromperam as operações nos terminais de grãos, forçando as transportadoras a adiar ou cancelar o carregamento de dezenas de cargas durante a alta temporada de exportação.
O grupo norte-americano de commodities agrícolas ADM (ADM.N) informou nesta quarta-feira que um ataque com drone em 31 de agosto danificou seu terminal de grãos UEP no porto ucraniano de Odessa, no Mar Negro.
Os compradores pagaram cerca de US$315 a US$330 por tonelada, incluindo custo e frete, pelo trigo branco premium australiano, enquanto os negócios com trigo argentino foram fechados por cerca de US$310 a US$315 por tonelada, segundo os operadores.
Isso se compara à maioria das cargas do Mar Negro contratadas por cerca de US$260 a US$280 por tonelada para chegadas entre agosto e setembro.
Os contratos futuros de referência de Chicago subiram cerca de 35% desde o final de junho, impulsionados em grande parte pela escassez de suprimentos do Mar Negro, enquanto os preços à vista dispararam entre os exportadores concorrentes -- Argentina, Austrália e Estados Unidos.
O trigo em Chicago atingiu seu nível mais alto em três anos e meio na terça-feira, após relatos de que Moscou havia rejeitado uma moratória sobre os ataques na região do Mar Negro e lançado ataques noturnos contra a infraestrutura portuária ucraniana.
Processadores de grãos na Ásia reservaram cerca de 2,0 milhões a 2,5 milhões de toneladas de trigo do Mar Negro para embarque entre julho e setembro, o que representa cerca de 30% a 50% da demanda de importação. No entanto, os crescentes atrasos nos embarques têm alimentado preocupações de que uma parte dos grãos possa não chegar aos compradores.
Além da Indonésia, outros compradores asiáticos de trigo do Mar Negro incluem Bangladesh, Vietnã, Malásia, Tailândia e Sri Lanka.
Embora os compradores estejam garantindo grandes volumes de trigo australiano e argentino, alguns recorreram a remessas em contêineres para atender às necessidades imediatas, afirmaram os operadores.
"Algumas moageiras estão preferindo contêineres, pois combinaram com os fornecedores de adiar ainda mais a chegada das cargas do Mar Negro", disse um segundo trader com sede na Ásia. "Elas não querem se expor demais aos preços altos, então estão usando contêineres para atender às suas necessidades imediatas."
items.raw_description: Importadores asiáticos de trigo adquiriram pelo menos meio milhão de toneladas métricas de trigo australiano e argentino em negócios recentes, segundo três fontes do setor, à medida que os compradores se apressam para substituir cargas do Mar Negro atrasadas por ataques a navios e à infraestrutura de exportação de grãos.

items.title: How the auto sector could be driving force in bid to scale plastic recycling
items.author: Mike Scott
items.creator: Mike Scott
items.summary: Every year, more than 800,000 metric tons of plastic from vehicles at the end of their lives are burned or sent to landfill in Europe. But this has to change, fast.
items.body:
Every year, more than 800,000 metric tons of plastic from vehicles at the end of their lives are burned or sent to landfill in Europe. But this has to change, fast.
Under the EU’s proposed revision of its End-of-Life Vehicles Regulation (EU ELV), new vehicles will have to contain at least 15% recycled plastic within six years, rising to 25% within a decade, and at least a fifth of that material must have come from vehicles that have been scrapped.
With around 10.8 million new passenger cars registered in the EU in 2025 (20% of which are not made in Europe) and 200–240 kg of plastic per vehicle, the 15% recycled content target implies the production of roughly 350,000 tons of recycled plastic annually.
At the moment, no more than 2.5% of plastic from end-of-life vehicles finds its way into new cars, so there is a big gap.
A new initiative to tackle this shortfall has emerged – not from carmakers but from a group of chemicals companies.
The Global Impact Coalition (GIC), a platform focused on cutting carbon and introducing circularity into the chemicals sector, created a pilot project to show how a combination of mechanical and chemical recycling of plastic could help the automotive industry meet its targets.
The project involved eight companies from the chemicals and waste industries and saw 100 end-of-life vehicles put through a process of dismantling, shredding and sorting to see if plastic components could be recovered from old cars and turned into material that is good enough to be used again.
More than 800,000 metric tons annually of plastic from end-of-life vehicles are burned or scrapped. REUTERS/Jose Luis Gonzalez No single company in the automotive recycling chain has both the incentive and the capability to build this system unilaterally, so the entire value chain – from chemicals producers to carmakers to dismantlers and waste processors – needs to come together.
“The raw materials exist but the system to convert them into automotive-grade feedstock doesn’t,” says Charlie Tan, CEO of the GIC. “There is a gap between regulatory ambition and how prepared the current system is to meet those goals.”
The pilot proved that while it is technically feasible to recover and recycle plastics, there is still a long way to go on costs before a viable business case can be made. Nonetheless, says Tan, “the conversation is shifting from ‘can recycling automotive plastic work technologically’ to ‘can we build an economically viable supply chain and what would everyone’s role be?’”.
Although the pilot project was led by the chemicals sector, it is carmakers that sit at the heart of circularity. “What makes the automotive sector unique is that it has one of the biggest volume feedstocks that can be collected for chemical recycling,” says Ana Sofia Almagro, global projects lead at the GIC.
For plastics producers to scale up chemical recycling, they need long-term demand signals as well as a source of reliable, high-quality feedstock. Because of their need to use plastic recovered from old cars in new vehicles as a result of the new rules, automotive original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) provide both. “There is an unusually close link between the supply of recycled plastic and the demand from OEMs for recycled plastic,” says Almagro. “That could provide the demand signal that chemicals companies need to build facilities for more chemical recycling.”
The pilot project found that current sorting methods, and the make-up of many car parts, mean that the quality of recovered materials falls short of the requirements of today’s models. But with carmakers as both supplier and customer they can act to change that, says Dr Dirk Voeste, chief sustainability officer at Volkswagen.
A Volkswagen employee works on a production line at the VW headquarters in Wolfsburg, Germany. REUTERS/Fabian Bimmer “We’re looking at being more circular by design, and what that means. How do we design the car of the future not just to reduce the amount of polymers that we use, but also to make it easier to disassemble? If we design a part differently, we can save so much time at disassembly,” says Voeste.
Volkswagen is also working with the German government’s Open Hybrid Lab-Factory (OHLF), which is based in Wolfsburg, the company’s headquarters. OHLF’s research campus focuses on how to develop and produce materials that are resource-efficient, lightweight and circular.
VW brand Audi, through its Material Loop project, is looking at ways to recycle not just plastics but also steel, aluminium and glass. There are well-established and successful recycling systems in place for these materials, but plastics are much harder to deal with.
Plastics recycled mechanically are weaker than virgin plastic and can only be recycled a few times. There are also problems mixing different plastics, which melt at different temperatures, with contamination and the growing amount of packaging that uses composite or multi-layer materials, which are difficult to separate.
“A key challenge for products that contain plastic is that they are very mixed together, and they have been bolted, welded or glued,” says Michael Puffer, head of alternative and new materials sourcing at chemicals producer Covestro. “It’s difficult to get material of a purity that it can be used as a feedstock for new products.”
Recycling plastic chemically offers more flexibility because it reduces plastic waste to chemical building blocks, which can be used to create virgin plastic. But currently there is just 0.29 million tons of chemical recycling capacity operational in Europe, Almagro says, with a pipeline of planned projects with a capacity of 2.8 million tons. This compares to the 53 million tons of plastic waste produced in the EU in 2019, which is forecast to double by 2060, surpassing 100 million tons a year. “What is stopping more capacity being built is a lack of credible demand signals, which is almost as important as the price of the feedstock,” says Puffer.
Bottles containing lithium hydroxide and nickel salts are displayed on a table at the battery recycling pilot plant in France. REUTERS/Gonzalo Fuentes Chemicals companies are keen to build more chemical recycling capacity because they are under pressure to cut their own emissions. Covestro, for example, is committed to becoming fully circular, and “climate neutral” by 2050. But collaboration and partnerships will be key to accelerating progress, Puffer says.
“Circularity is a new business model,” says Voeste. “In the old days, we would design and produce a vehicle and then never see it again. Now, we want it back. We want spare parts, materials.
It’s a completely different way of thinking than the old linear model. There are untapped revenue pools that we have not seen before.” These range from remanufactured parts to reduced raw material, resource and energy use. Other potential revenue streams include second-life batteries and as-a-service and subscription models.
But carmakers are facing growing competition for low-carbon molecules, in particular from the shipping and aviation sectors. And the demand signals are not yet clear enough to scale up production, the goal of the next phase of GIC’s project.
A whole new digital infrastructure will also be needed to allow all parts of the value chain to trace used plastic on its journey to becoming new products, and to allow carmakers to show they are complying with the regulations. “We need some kind of digital passport for cars,” says Voeste. “If you know everything about a car, it will be much cheaper and easier to disassemble.” The new ELV regulation introduces, among other things, a Circularity Vehicle Passport – a digital record of a vehicle’s materials, components and circularity data.
Tan expects that there will be lessons for other sectors, ranging from shipping to fast-moving consumer goods and fashion. One area that Covestro has identified as very promising is mattresses. Some 44 million mattresses are disposed of every year in Europe, says Puffer, and they are full of polyurethane foam that can be repurposed.
But when it comes to scaling up plastic recycling and making its production more circular, the automative sector is expected to be the driving force.
This article is part of The Ethical Corporation's in-depth briefing on the circular economy. To download a free PDF, click here

items.title: 米ISM非製造業指数､6カ月ぶり高水準－仕入れ価格は4年ぶりの高さ
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米供給管理協会（ISM）が発表した8月の非製造業総合景況指数は前月比で上昇し、6カ月ぶりの高水準となった。堅調な需要と事業活動の活発化が押し上げ要因となった。

新規受注の伸びは加速し、2023年2月以来の高水準となったほか、事業活動を示す指数は2022年以来の高い水準となった。受注残は7カ月連続で拡大した。

8月は鉱業、不動産、宿泊・飲食サービスなど12業種が活動拡大を報告した。一方、5業種は縮小した。

米国のサービス業は、底堅い個人消費や安定した雇用市場、健全な企業投資に支えられてきた。ただし、サプライチェーンの混乱や関税、経済全体に広がるコスト上昇への対応も迫られている。

ISMが算出する同業界の資材・サービスの仕入れ価格指数は8月に72.6へ上昇し、2022年半ば以来の高水準となった。

インフレ率は2022年の水準を大きく下回っているものの、消費者物価と生産者物価を示す指標は2月のイラン戦争開始以降上昇し、高止まりしており、多くの企業に圧力をかけている。

FAST

Sept 3 : Ireland's Katie Taylor will bring down the curtain on her career with a fight against Flora Pili of France at Dublin's Croke Park on Saturday in which she will try to achieve a fairytale finish to an extraordinary boxing story. 
Taylor, 40, has come a long way from covering her hair and pretending to be a boy to get fights in the junior ranks, and the showdown in front of thousands of fanatical Irish fans is her chance to bow out as the undisputed super-lightweight champion of the world. 
"I'm not sure if there's any other country in the world where 80,000 people would turn up for a female athlete," Taylor told reporters in Dublin. 
"I'm so grateful for the support, I'm blown away by it, to be honest. I want to put on a performance worthy of everyone's support over the years. This country has travelled around the world to watch me fight ... and they'll be with me again on Saturday night."

Of Ireland's 42 Olympic medals, 19 have come in the boxing ring, and Taylor's gold at the 2012 Olympics was a defining moment for the women's sport. Four years later she turned pro, amassing titles and professional purses that she could only have dreamed of when starting out. 
A native of the seaside town of Bray, just south of Dublin, Taylor tore through the professional ranks, using her speed and aggression to win the WBA title in her seventh professional fight, and she has barely looked back since. 
Together with Amanda Serrano, she became the first woman to headline a card at New York's Madison Square Garden when they fought in April 2022, with Taylor winning a fight for the ages in a razor-thin split decision. 
It has, however, not all been plain sailing. A gangland shooting at the Regency Hotel near Croke Park in which one man was killed at a 2016 weigh-in brought professional boxing in Ireland to a standstill. 
ONLY DEFEAT
When she finally got to fight in the Irish capital in May 2023, Taylor suffered the only defeat of her professional career as Chantelle Cameron edged her on the judges' scorecards, and though she won a rematch at the same venue six months later, the original loss still stung. 
Now, though, she has the chance to go out in a blaze of glory. The 29-year-old Pili will provide a tough test, but Taylor's focus is solely on getting her hand raised one last time.
Taylor performed an open workout on Wednesday at a venue on the north side of Dublin, picking out a young girl from the crowd to share the ring with her, and 10-year-old Clodagh Keating burst into tears as her idol laced up a pair of boxing gloves for her. 
"To feel the atmosphere even in this small arena, I can't imagine what Saturday night's going to be like, and getting the chance to meet little Clodagh there, who got into the ring, this is what it's all about for me," Taylor said. 
“In a few days, I’ll make my last ring walk and I’ll look back on this in a few years and I imagine I’ll be overwhelmed.”

Source: Reuters

FAST

LONDON, Sept 3 : Oil prices rose on Thursday after U.S. strikes on Iran and renewed Israeli threats against Tehran revived concerns about disruptions to Middle East supplies.
Brent crude futures were up 59 cents, or 0.62 per cent, at $96.22 a barrel by 1327 GMT while U.S. West Texas Intermediate crude futures rose 78 cents, or 0.86 per cent, to $91.79. Both contracts were heading for their fourth day of gains and hit six-week highs earlier in the session.
Iran's health minister said 18 people were killed and 108 wounded in Tuesday night's U.S. strikes across Iran. The Iranian Red Crescent said four people were killed and 67 wounded at a wedding ceremony near the coast of the Strait of Hormuz. 
Three Iranian Army pilots were killed in the U.S. strikes, the semi-official Tasnim news agency reported.

The attacks were the most substantial exchange of fire between the U.S. and Iran since July. The war, which began with U.S.-Israeli strikes at the end of February, is in its seventh month.
Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz renewed warnings that Israel would "cripple" Iran's military and civilian infrastructure, including energy facilities, if Tehran launched attacks against it.
Saxo Bank analyst Ole Hansen said Katz's comments had helped to push oil prices higher.
FEWER VESSELS TRANSIT STRAIT
Six commodity vessels transited the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday, down from 11 a day earlier and well below the 10-day average of around 13, preliminary shipping data showed on Thursday.
"The oil market remains tight, with oil inventories still declining globally translating into higher prices. Some support might have also come from ongoing tensions in the Middle East," said UBS energy analyst Giovanni Staunovo.
Meanwhile, Iran added ships to the list of vessels it deems non-compliant and subject to fines, confiscation or detention if they try to sail through the strait. 
Iraqi vessels are among those Iran has allowed to pass through Hormuz.
Iraq increased its oil exports to around 2.34 million barrels per day in August from about 1.35 million bpd in July, two Iraqi energy officials said on Wednesday, with September exports also expected to increase as heavy discounts and Iranian approvals for Iraqi tankers encouraged buyers.
Higher oil prices and the implications for inflation led to increased bets on a Federal Reserve interest rate hike this month.

items.title: Strong demand boosts US services sector activity in August
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: U.S. services sector activity picked up in August as strong demand lifted new orders to a 3-1/2-year high and drove input prices higher, suggesting inflation could remain elevated and compel the Federal Reserve to hike interest rates before the end of this year.
items.body:
U.S. services sector activity picked up in August as strong demand lifted new orders to a 3-1/2-year high and drove input prices higher, suggesting inflation could remain elevated and compel the Federal Reserve to hike interest rates before the end of this year.
The Institute for Supply Management said on Thursday its nonmanufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index advanced to 55.4 last month from 54.1 in July. A reading above 50 indicates growth in the services sector, which accounts for more than two-thirds of U.S. economic activity. Economists polled by Reuters had forecast the PMI would climb to 54.2. The current PMI level is consistent with solid economic growth in the third quarter.
The survey's measure of new orders received by services businesses surged to 60.9, the highest reading since February 2023, from 57.2 in July. The strength in orders aligns with robust domestic demand, which is partly being fueled by an artificial intelligence spending boom.
With demand showing no signs of cooling, supply chains remained stretched last month. The survey's measure of supplier deliveries eased to 51.3 from 52.8 in July. A reading above 50 indicates slower deliveries. That measure has slowed for 21 straight months, pushing up input prices.
Supplier delivery performance was initially impacted by tariffs on imports and most recently by the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran, now in its seventh month.
The survey's measure of prices paid by businesses for inputs increased to 72.6 from 70.3 in July, suggesting inflation could stay above the U.S. central bank's 2% target for a while. Fed Chairman [USN:L6N44P0MM TEXT:"Kevin Warsh"] said last week the central bank will "have work to do" if policymakers don't get the confidence they need that inflation is falling to the 2% target.
Financial markets are pricing in a roughly 64% chance that the Fed will raise its benchmark overnight interest rate by 25 basis points at its September 15-16 policy meeting, according to CME Group's FedWatch tool. That rate is currently set in the 3.50%-3.75% range.
Despite the surge in orders, services sector employment remained subdued last month. Economists say businesses are reluctant to add to headcounts because of policy uncertainty. The survey's employment sub-index was little changed at 47.8, suggesting a possible downside risk to nonfarm payrolls for August.
A Reuters survey of economists expects the Labor Department on Friday to report that payrolls rebounded by 56,000 jobs last month after a [USN:L1N44U0SB TEXT:"surprise decline"] of 23,000 in July. That rebound would partly reflect a recovery in local government education payrolls. Some economists are, however, bracing for a second straight month of job losses after Temporary Protected Status for hundreds of [USN:L6N4431EV TEXT:"thousands of Haitians"] recently ended, impacting their work authorization.

items.title: エヌビディア、ハギングフェイスの買収で合意－約2兆円
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： エヌビディアは3日、AIスタートアップの米ハギングフェイスを約130億ドル（約2兆円）で買収することで合意したと発表した。

エヌビディアは、ハギングフェイスのプラットフォームの開放性を保ち、従来の運営方針を維持するとしている。エヌビディアは「ハギングフェイスは引き続き、モデル開発者やデベロッパー、ユーザーが自ら選んだモデルやデータセットをアップロード、ダウンロードできるようにし、他社の半導体もサポートする」と説明した。

AIを普及させ、顧客層を拡大しようとするエヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（CEO）にとって、ハギングフェイスの買収は、これまでで最大の一手となる。買収によりエヌビディアは、開発者がAIモデルを公開・共有する主要プラットフォームの一つを傘下に収める。

フアン氏は、AIが少数の大企業の技術に寡占されないよう、オープンソースモデルの普及を後押しする方針を掲げている。AI大手の一部はエヌビディアの最大顧客だが、独自半導体の開発も積極的に進めている。

ハギングフェイスは2016年創業で、利用者が自由に利用できるAIモデルを共有するプラットフォームを運営している。同社の企業価値は3年前の資金調達ラウンドで、45億ドルと評価された。

エヌビディアはもともと、アルファベット傘下のグーグル、アマゾン・ドット・コム、インテル、セールスフォースなどとともに、ハギングフェイスに出資していた。

Tata Trusts said it received relief in a regulatory probe, potentially allowing the controlling shareholder of Tata Group’s holding company to resume business as usual as it seeks to pick a new chairman.

The Trusts received an order from the Maharashtra Charity Commissioner dated Sept. 2, closing a complaint related to a 1989 share transfer, according to a statement Thursday. That complaint had triggered restrictions that prevented one of the Trusts from convening internal meetings.

Yen jumps on BOJ hike bets, dollar slips on Waller comments

NEW YORK, Sept 3 : The yen jumped by 2 per cent against the U.S. dollar on Thursday as traders ramped up bets on a Bank of Japan interest rate hike, while analysts pointed to BOJ data showing no official intervention behind the currency's strong gains on Wednesday.
The dollar, meanwhile, added to losses after Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said that if upcoming data confirms that inflation pressures are cooling off, he is inclined to argue in favor of keeping interest rates steady at the U.S. central bank's next policy meeting.
A sharp, sudden rise in the yen against the dollar on Wednesday fueled speculation that Japanese officials had intervened to shore up the currency, after gains from a historic U.S.-Japan action in late July began to fade.
But with no evidence of official action, analysts say the move instead reflects bets that the BOJ could raise rates by more than previously expected when it meets on September 17 and 18.

“BoJ daily account data released today indicated there was no USD selling / yen buying by the MoF on Wednesday. Reports from market participants also indicate there were no 'rate checks' by the MoF yesterday,” said Jeremy Stretch, chief international strategist at CIBC Capital Markets.
During a rate check, a government or central bank asks financial institutions to quote an exchange rate but does not buy or sell.
Hawkish comments from BOJ board member Hajime Takata were cited as a factor behind yen strength. Takata said on Wednesday the central bank should conduct interest rate hikes nimbly to counter intensifying inflationary pressures, rather than adhere to a fixed semiannual pace anticipated by markets.
Markets are now pricing in 75 per cent odds of a 25-basis-point BOJ hike this month, with some traders speculating that an even larger increase is possible. An additional hike in October is also seen as a possibility, though not a likely one.
Market pricing “is too hawkish in our view. However, the continued market speculation over a faster pace of rate hikes means USD/JPY longs could still get squeezed in the coming days,” said Stretch.
The Japanese yen  strengthened 1.99 per cent to 155.6 per dollar. It is approaching the 155.21 level that was the yen high after the July intervention. If it surpasses this level it will be the strongest since May 6.
The Japanese currency has struggled to find fundamental support, coming under pressure from still-wide interest rate differentials, fiscal worries and a renewed spike in energy prices.
WAITING ON PAYROLLS
The dollar added to losses as traders pared bets on a September rate hike after comments from Waller.
The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies including the yen and the euro, fell 0.58 per cent to 99.02, with the euro  up 0.3 per cent at $1.1622. Sterling  strengthened 0.18 per cent to $1.3508.
Traders are now pricing in 46 per cent odds of a Fed rate hike this month, down from 59 per cent before his comments. They had raised bets on a September hike after hawkish comments from Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh on Friday.
This week’s main U.S. economic release is U.S. jobs data on Friday, which is expected to show that employers added 56,000 jobs last month, according to the median estimate in a Reuters poll of economists. That would follow July's surprise drop of 23,000 jobs.
Consumer and producer price inflation reports for August are due next week. 
Elsewhere, the Swiss franc strengthened after data showed a jump in inflation to 0.8 per cent year-on-year, up from 0.4 per cent in July, raising the possibility that the Swiss National Bank may raise interest rates away from zero.
Against the Swiss franc, the dollar weakened 0.71 per cent to  0.807.

Source: Reuters

items.body: Bloomberg Línea — Tras los comicios generales del 12 de abril y la segunda vuelta presidencial del 7 de junio, Perú tendrá una jornada electoral más en 2026. El domingo 4 de octubre, los ciudadanos están convocados a las urnas para escoger a las autoridades regionales y municipales. Las autoridades locales por las que podrán votar más de 26,3 millones de peruanos, de acuerdo con la Oficina Nacional de Procesos Electorales (ONPE), son: Un punto para destacar, asociado con la elección del gobernador regional, uno de los cargos de mayor relevancia en estos comicios, es que tendrá que sumar al menos el 30% de los votos válidos para vencer. Ver más: ¿Invertir en Colombia o Perú? JPMorgan tiene razones para preferir a uno de los dos En caso de que ninguno de los candidatos cuente con este porcentaje de votos, “se procede a una segunda elección dentro de los treinta días calendario siguientes a la proclamación de los cómputos oficiales”, de acuerdo con la Ley de Elecciones Regionales. Ahora mismo, estas son las etapas restantes del proceso electoral: Los peruanos que deseen saber si son miembros de mesa de las elecciones regionales y municipales 2026 pueden ingresar a este link , donde solo es necesario ingresar el DNI. En estos comicios, cada mesa de votación estará integrada por tres miembros titulares y seis suplentes. Se sortean seis suplentes con el objetivo de asegurar la instalación de las mesas desde las 6:00 a. m., de modo que la jornada electoral pueda iniciar a las 7:00 a. m. y desarrollarse sin contratiempos hasta las 5:00 p. m., “garantizando que los electores sufraguen sin demoras”, dice la ONPE. En Perú, los ciudadanos que son escogidos como miembros de mesa reciben una compensación económica equivalente al 3% de una Unidad Impositiva Tributaria (UIT), es decir, S/ 165. De acuerdo con la ONPE, los miembros de mesa que ejerzan su función el día de la elección y que también se hayan capacitado, tienen derecho a un día de descanso remunerado y no compensable. Sept 3 : Players who featured at the 2026 World Cup generated more than $3.3 billion in international transfer fees during the recently concluded mid-year transfer window, FIFA said on Thursday.
More than 260 World Cup players from 47 nationalities changed clubs during the window, accounting for over a third of the record $9.89 billion spent on international transfer fees in men's football, according to soccer's global governing body.
"More than 12,500 international transfers were registered around the world, also setting a new record for the number of transfers during a mid-year window," FIFA said in a study.

The spending spree came after Spain lifted the World Cup in July, highlighting how performances on football's biggest stage helped drive record spending across the global market.
Several high-profile World Cup players secured big-money moves during the window, including Spain midfielder Rodri's switch from Manchester City to Barcelona and France winger Bradley Barcola's transfer from Paris St Germain to Liverpool.
Women's football also posted records, with international transfer spending more than doubling from 2025 to $28.6 million, FIFA said.
"A total of 1,406 international transfers were registered in women’s professional football – the highest number ever recorded and a 19.2 per cent increase compared with the previous record," FIFA said.
English clubs led the spending in the men's and women's international transfer markets, accounting for $3.02 billion in men's transfer fees and $8.0 million in the women's game.

items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
[ワシントン　３日　ロイター] - 米労働省が３日発表した８月２９日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は２０万６０００件と、前週比２０００件の小幅増にとどまり、８月末時点で労働市場の状況に実質的な変化がないことを示唆した。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は２０万５０００件だった。 

申請件数は今年のレンジ（１８万９０００─２３万件）の下限付近で推移しており、エコノミストが指摘する「低採用・低解雇」の労働市場の状況と一致している。

８月２２日までの週の継続受給件数（季節調整済み）は１７７万９０００件と、前週から８０００件増加した。

今回の調査は４日発表の８月の雇用統計の調査期間と重なっていない。

また、再就職あっせん会社チャレンジャー・グレイ・アンド・クリスマスによると、 米国企業が今年１─８月に発表した採用計画数は前年同期比で３７％増加した。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は２０万５０００件だった。 

申請件数は今年のレンジ（１８万９０００─２３万件）の下限付近で推移しており、エコノミストが指摘する「低採用・低解雇」の労働市場の状況と一致している。

８月２２日までの週の継続受給件数（季節調整済み）は１７７万９０００件と、前週から８０００件増加した。

今回の調査は４日発表の８月の雇用統計の調査期間と重なっていない。

また、再就職あっせん会社チャレンジャー・グレイ・アンド・クリスマスによると、 米国企業が今年１─８月に発表した採用計画数は前年同期比で３７％増加した。 ただ、同社は「これらの職が迅速に埋まっているようには見えない」と指摘した。８月の人員削減計画数は５８％増の５万２８８１人となった一方、年初来の発表済み一時解雇（レイオフ）数は前年同期比で４１％減少している。低水準の解雇件数が、労働市場と経済全体を支えていることを示唆した。

items.title: Commerzbank to buy back own shares for €1.2 billion
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Commerzbank , the German lender facing a takeover approach by UniCredit , said on Thursday it would launch a new share buyback programme of up to €1.2 billion ($1.39 billion) to boost the return for shareholders.
items.body:
Commerzbank (CBKG.DE) , the German lender facing a takeover approach by UniCredit (CRDI.MI) , said on Thursday it would launch a new share buyback programme of up to €1.2 billion ($1.39 billion) to boost the return for shareholders.
Commerzbank, valued at about €44 billion in total on the stock market, said the share buyback would begin Friday and run until February 10, 2027, at the latest.
“With this next share buyback, we continue to consistently execute our attractive capital return policy,” said CEO Bettina Orlopp.
The acquired shares will be cancelled, as was the case in two previous share buyback programmes, the lender added.
Resistance by the bank and by the German government to a [USN:L6N44N0TQ TEXT:"takeover has weakened"] since the Italian lender in July reached a stake of nearly 50%, which is sufficient to sway shareholder resolutions, including naming board members.
German Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil plans to meet UniCredit CEO Andrea Orcel, sources told Reuters last month, in the clearest sign yet that Berlin will engage directly with the Italian bank over the takeover attempt.

items.title: 〔ロイターネクスト〕-ウォラーＦＲＢ理事、インフレ鈍化なら金利据え置き支持
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Michael S. Derby　Howard Schneider

[ワシントン　３日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Michael S. Derby　Howard Schneider

[ワシントン　３日　ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のウォラー理事は３日、今後発表される経済指標でインフレ圧力の鈍化が確認されれば、１５─１６日の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で政策金利の据え置きを支持する考えを示した。

ウォラー氏は、ロイター主催イベント「ロイターネクスト」で、「適切な政策スタンスに関する自分自身の判断は、８月のインフレ動向から得られる情報に大きく左右される」とし、「（インフレ率が）２％目標に向けて進展し続けていることが確認できれば、政策金利を現行水準に据え置くことを支持する用意がある」と語った。

同時に、利上げの可能性も依然としてあると指摘。「インフレ指標が予想以上に強い内容になれば（今月のＦＯＭＣで）利上げを検討する」と述べた。

現在３．５０─３．７５％のフェデラルファンド（ＦＦ）金利誘導目標については、「総需要を抑制する効果は限定的にとどまっている」とし、「インフレが多少加速するだけでも、一段と引き締め的な政策を支持する方向に傾く可能性がある」と指摘。同時に、インフレ率は目標を「かなり上回っている」としながらも、「目標達成に向けて緩やかながらも着実な改善が続いている」との認識を示した。

＜インフレ対応が政策の主眼＞

ウォラー氏はこの日、経済全体の底堅さや労働市場の相対的な安定を踏まえ、現時点での政策上の主な焦点はインフレにあると述べた。

その上で、最近インフレを押し上げてきた要因の一部は、今後は大きな物価上昇圧力の源泉にはならないとの見方を示した。「エネルギー価格の上昇や関税は、現時点では持続的なインフレ圧力の重要な源泉とは見ていない」と発言。関税引き上げの影響はすでに経済に浸透済みで、中東の紛争に関連したエネルギー価格上昇も他の物価に波及する兆しはないと付け加えた。

一方、インフレの上振れリスクもいくつか指摘。「エネルギー価格は再び上昇しており、２０２６年初めと比べて依然としてかなり高い水準にある。加えて、経済はＡＩ関連投資に伴う技術関連財の価格上昇圧力や、追加的な関税引き上げの可能性にも直面している」と述べた。

＜米国債の「安全性プレミアム」消失＞

ウォラー氏はまた、安全かつ流動性の高い米国債に対するプレミアムはもはや存在しないとの認識を示した。米国債利回り上昇の背景として、財政状況への懸念に加え、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連インフラ投資との資金獲得競争、さらに米国債価格を押し上げ利回りを押し下げてきた「安全性プレミアム」の低下を示す証拠が増えていることを挙げた。

その上で、「これは自分の中立金利の推計を引き上げる要因になっている。つまり一定のインフレ率に対して政策金利は高めになる、言い換えれば自分たちが思っているほど引き締め的ではないかもしれないということだ」と述べた。

＜市場の利上げ観測後退＞

正式発言後のコメントでは、物価上昇圧力の鈍化を見極めるため、今後の指標に対してやや辛抱強く臨みたいとの考えを示した。「ここでジョン・レノンの言葉を借りたい。ディスインフレにチャンスを与えよう」と発言。金融政策とインフレを巡っては「来年まで待とうとは言わないが、多少なりとも改善が見られるかどうか、様子を見よう」と語った。 

市場ではこれまで、今月のＦＯＭＣで０．２５％ポイントの利上げが実施される確率が相応にあると織り込まれてきた。ここ数週間、幅広い当局者がインフレへの懸念を表明し続けており、利上げを求める向きや、目標を上回り続ける物価上昇圧力を押し戻すための行動に前向きな姿勢を示す向きもあった。

ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長は先週、ワイオミング州で開かれたカンザスシティー地区連銀主催の経済シンポジウム「ジャクソンホール会議」で講演し、インフレ圧力が和らがなければ、それを確実に和らげるためのＦＲＢの行動が必要になる可能性が高いとの見方を示していた。

ウォラー氏の発言公表後、トレーダーは今月のＦＯＭＣでの利上げに対する見方を後退させた。利上げ確率は従来の約６０％からほぼ五分五分の水準まで低下した。

items.title: ウォラーFRB理事、9月の金利判断は8月インフレ統計が「大きく左右」
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）のウォラー理事は、次回の金利判断について、来週発表される8月のインフレデータに「大きく左右される」と述べた。次回の連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）で利上げ支持に傾くのに、それほど強い材料は必要ない可能性があるとの考えも示した。

ウォラー氏は3日、ロイター通信主催のイベント向けの講演で「インフレ率が2%目標に向けて引き続き改善しているのであれば、政策金利を現行水準に据え置くことを支持する用意がある」と発言。

「しかし、インフレが強い内容となれば、利上げを検討するだろう」と話した。発言内容は準備原稿に基づく。

ウォラー氏は現在の金融政策について、景気をやや抑制しているとの認識を表明。その上で、「インフレがそれほど大きく加速しなくても、より引き締め的な政策を支持する方向に傾く可能性がある。インフレ率2%に向けた進展が8月に逆行したことを示す証拠があれば、われわれの政策スタンスを小幅に調整することで、再び2%に向けた軌道に戻るよう後押しできる」と述べた。

それでもウォラー氏は、物価上昇圧力には改善の兆しが見られるとして、やや楽観的な見方も示した。

「インフレ率はFOMCが掲げる2%目標を依然として大きく上回っているが、最近のデータは、ディスインフレの一定の兆しがようやく表れ始めたことを示唆している」と語った。

items.title: AbbVie's blood cancer therapy lowers disease progression, death risk in trial
items.author: Puyaan Singh
items.creator: Puyaan Singh
items.summary: AbbVie said on Thursday its therapy for a type of blood cancer has improved patients' response rate to treatment and reduced the risk of disease progression or death, meeting the main goals of a late-stage trial.
items.body:
AbbVie (ABBV.N) said on Thursday its therapy for a type of blood cancer has improved patients' response rate to treatment and reduced the risk of disease progression or death, meeting the main goals of a late-stage trial.
As biosimilars chip away at sales of its arthritis treatment Humira, once its top-selling drug, the company is turning to acquisitions and other disease areas such as neuroscience and oncology to drive growth.
The therapy, etentamig, showed an objective response rate of 74% in patients with refractory multiple myeloma, higher than the 45.7% recorded by standard treatments chosen by the trial investigator. ORR is the percentage of patients in a clinical trial whose cancer shrinks or disappears after treatment.
Etentamig also increased survival without progression of the disease, and reduced the risk of the cancer worsening or death by 60% compared to other treatments in the 393-patient trial.
"For AbbVie, the data add credibility to oncology but do not change the investment debate," said Citi analyst Geoffrey Meacham. Commercial execution for newer drugs Skyrizi and Rinvoq remains paramount, while investors are increasingly focused on "whether additional transactions can deepen AbbVie's 2030s growth profile."
The trial included patients who received a median of three prior lines of treatment with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma, a form of blood cancer that has returned after a period of remission or has stopped responding to treatment.
After 12 months, 87.9% of patients receiving etentamig were still alive, compared to 72% of patients receiving standard treatments.
Etentamig engages T-cells, which protect from infections and fight cancer, by targeting two proteins.
Meachem said etentamig looks most differentiated as an additional post-CAR-T cell therapy, rather than a replacement for Johnson & Johnson's (JNJ.N) Carvykti or Gilead's (GILD.O) anito-cel. "CAR-T offers deep responses and a treatment holiday, while etentamig offers immediate availability, monthly administration and broader treatment-center access."

items.title: Los recortes de empleo en EE.UU. caen a su nivel más bajo en cuatro años
items.author: Julia Fanzeres
items.summary: Las empresas estadounidenses anunciaron 529.914 recortes de plantilla en los primeros ocho meses de 2026, mientras los planes de contratación alcanzaron su mayor nivel desde 2023.
items.body: Bloomberg — Los recortes de plantilla previstos en Estados Unidos descendieron en los primeros ocho meses de 2026 hasta alcanzar el nivel más bajo de los últimos cuatro años, lo que se suma a los indicios de que las empresas siguen mostrándose reacias a reducir su plantilla. Las empresas han anunciado 529.914 recortes de plantilla en lo que va de año, el total más bajo desde 2022, cuando la demanda de mano de obra tras la pandemia aún era intensa, según datos publicados este jueves por la consultora de recolocación Challenger, Gray & Christmas Inc. Por otra parte, los planes de contratación en los ocho meses transcurridos hasta agosto se situaron en su nivel más alto desde 2023. Ver más: Ofertas de empleo en EE.UU. suben ligeramente a 7,27 millones mientras los despidos disminuyen “Lo que nos gustaría observar, ante el bajo número de despidos, es un aumento de la actividad de contratación”, afirmó Andy Challenger, director de ingresos de la empresa. “Aunque las empresas están elaborando planes para contratar a más trabajadores que el año pasado, según nuestras cifras, no parece que esos puestos se estén cubriendo con rapidez”. Muchos economistas siguen caracterizando el mercado laboral estadounidense como un entorno de “pocas contrataciones y pocos despidos” que ha prevalecido durante los últimos años. Ver más: Revisan a la baja el crecimiento del empleo en EE.UU.: 79.000 puestos menos de lo estimado Las solicitudes semanales de prestaciones por desempleo han mostrado pocos indicios de una actividad generalizada de despidos, y se espera que el informe mensual de empleo del gobierno, que se publicará el viernes, revele que la tasa de desempleo se mantuvo sin cambios en agosto, en el 4,1%. El informe de Challenger también indicó que, por primera vez desde febrero, la inteligencia artificial no fue la razón principal citada por los empleadores para los recortes de empleo anunciados, y que la reestructuración ocupó el primer puesto de la lista en agosto. No obstante, la IA siguió siendo la principal causa de los despidos en lo que va de año. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: REUTERS NEXT Waller, de la Fed, pide paciencia para que se manifieste la desinflación
items.author: Michael Derby, Howard Schneider
items.creator: Michael Derby, Howard Schneider
items.summary: El gobernador de la Reserva Federal, Christopher Waller, dijo el jueves que, si los próximos datos confirman que las presiones inflacionistas se están moderando, se inclinaría por defender el mantenimiento de las tasas de interés sin cambios en la próxima reunión de política monetaria del banco central estadounidense.
items.body:
El gobernador de la Reserva Federal, Christopher Waller, dijo el jueves que, si los próximos datos confirman que las presiones inflacionistas se están moderando, se inclinaría por defender el mantenimiento de las tasas de interés sin cambios en la próxima reunión de política monetaria del banco central estadounidense.
"Mi decisión sobre la orientación adecuada de la política monetaria dependerá en gran medida de lo que sepamos sobre la inflación de agosto", dijo Waller en un evento de Reuters NEXT Newsmaker celebrado en Washington.
"Si se sigue avanzando hacia nuestro objetivo del 2 %, estaré dispuesto a apoyar el mantenimiento de la tasa de interés oficial en su nivel actual", agregó Waller.
No obstante, advirtió de que también existe la posibilidad de una subida de las tasas de interés.
"Si la inflación se dispara, consideraría una subida de tasas" en la reunión del 15 y 16 de septiembre, señaló.
La tasa de interés de referencia actual de la Fed, entre el 3,50% y el 3,75%, "solo restringe ligeramente la demanda agregada", y "puede que no haga falta una gran aceleración de la inflación para que me decante por apoyar una política más restrictiva".
Waller señaló que la inflación se sitúa "significativamente sobre" el objetivo del 2%, pero añadió que "se está avanzando de forma lenta pero constante hacia" ese objetivo.
En declaraciones tras su comunicado oficial, Waller sostuvo que se inclina por mostrarse algo paciente con los datos que vayan surgiendo para confirmar que las presiones sobre los precios se están moderando.
"Voy a parafrasear aquí a John Lennon: 'Démosle una oportunidad a la desinflación' y esperemos una reunión para ver cómo se presentan los datos", dijo Waller. "Hay que arriesgarse un poco para ver si la desinflación continúa. Pero no voy a arriesgarme demasiado", añadió.
